def transform(grid):
    # Compress the four corner-to-center diagonals into a 3x3 grid:
    # corners stay at corners, the inner diagonal cells become edge cells,
    # and the center remains the center.
    return [
        [grid[0][0], grid[1][1], grid[0][4]],
        [grid[3][1], grid[2][2], grid[1][3]],
        [grid[4][0], grid[3][3], grid[4][4]],
    ]
